items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And he want to join my band and he had sung some numbers with me.

ctx.x: You know, Al Hibbler and I were great friends and I heard Al Hibbler when he was a kid in Little Rock, Arkansas.

And he want to join my band and he had sung some numbers with me. He'd sung some numbers with me. I'd already had a singer, so I... Later years he came to San Antonio, I used him at my nightclub, and then he went to Jim, like Shannon's band from J-Bone, to Duke's band, which I think was great. Only bad feature about Al, him, has always been his drinking problem. Being blind, he thought that, you know, people couldn't tell that. I imagine that's how you felt, but you can always tell when you felt it's not right.…

Well, we hope we got this publisher lined up in Texas. Well, I must have said that drinks that's a good book. Yeah. No, I just happened to, I wrote you, I met a guy from Texas and might have a whole series of books.
